en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Romanesque-style cathedral with four tall towers and an arcaded façade, set in a town with hills in the background. Handwritten-style caption at the bottom reads "Pécs-Székesegyház." The reverse side is a typical divided-back postcard layout with Hungarian text indicating rights reserved and the publisher's details.
